summary: Interfaces natively with Elgato Stream Decks via compiled N-API binary using IOHIDManager.

ports.name: Active
ports.text: Activates the driver, connecting to the device.

ports.name: Device Index
ports.text: Selects which connected device to control (if multiple are attached).

ports.name: Connection
ports.text: Outputs the connection object needed by the texture streaming operators.

ports.name: Is Connected
ports.text: Outputs true when a device is connected.

ports.name: Status
ports.text: String output showing connection details and current state.

ports.name: Device Info
ports.text: Returns metadata (name, key count, grid dimensions) of the connected device.

ports.name: Key Event
ports.text: Trigger fired whenever a button is pressed or released.

ports.name: Event Key Index
ports.text: The index of the button (0-indexed) associated with the event.

ports.name: Event Pressed
ports.text: True if pressed, false if released.
